node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer to 1.3.1. It gives the explicit T_U=Co^{A_R}_{P_U^R} o Co^A_{P_R} o v_U:B_U->S^{A_R}_{P_U^R} as an extended C_out*s-isomorphism, hence T_U is bijective by def-extended-delta-inclusion. The canonical coordinate map iota_U:B_U->q_U B_R q_U, iota_U(b_U)=(b_U,0), is bijective, and the displayed formula in the root says gamma_UU o iota_U=T_U. Hence gamma_UU=T_U o iota_U^{-1} is bijective. Because the datum in 1.2 is explicitly furnished by the outer-compression construction, this same T_U (written on q_U B_R q_U through iota_U) is its fixed U,U level-one map.
